title: Indeed US — form preview
description: INPUT FORM PREVIEW ONLY. These fields describe the requested Indeed US search. Job collection is disabled: no Indeed requests, proxy use, or applications. An authorized source must be connected before collection can be enabled.

queries.title: Job title, keywords, or company
queries.description: One search per entry. Process every entry independently, combine the results, and remove duplicates. For example, AI automation engineer and marketing manager are two searches.

locations.title: US city, state, ZIP code, or remote
locations.description: Optional locations within the United States. Empty means search the US market without a city restriction. These values do not select another country's Indeed site.

remoteTypes.title: Remote
remoteTypes.description: Select Remote, Hybrid work, or both. Leave empty for all work locations, including onsite. These choices require source-provided work-location information.

easyApplyOnly.title: Easily apply on Indeed only
easyApplyOnly.description: Require a verified Indeed Easy Apply label. Does not submit applications. This is not equivalent to an external company's simple application form.

jobTypes.title: Job type
jobTypes.description: Select any combination. Full-time and Part-time means either type is acceptable. Leave empty for all job types. Options here follow the supplied US search screenshots.

excludeGigJobs.title: Exclude gig jobs
excludeGigJobs.description: Exclude listings explicitly identified as gig jobs by the data source. Do not assume every contract or part-time job is a gig.

experienceLevel.title: Experience level
experienceLevel.description: Options follow the supplied US search screenshots. A selected level requires explicit source information; missing labels are not guessed.

fairChanceOnly.title: Encouraged to apply: Fair chance only
fairChanceOnly.description: Require the source's explicit Fair chance label. Do not infer this from unrelated wording in a description.

datePosted.title: Date posted
datePosted.description: Filter the original posting date supplied by the Indeed data source. Jobs you haven't seen is account/history-dependent and is not a date window.

minimumSalary.title: Minimum pay (USD)
minimumSalary.description: Optional minimum in US dollars for the selected pay period. A range qualifies when its upper bound reaches this amount. Unknown or non-comparable pay is excluded when this filter is set. No currency or period conversion.

salaryPeriod.title: Pay period
salaryPeriod.description: Require explicitly reported pay in this period, even when no minimum amount is entered. Choose Any pay period only when no minimum pay is set. Example: USD 85 per hour does not mean USD 85 per year.

maxResults.title: Maximum matching jobs
maxResults.description: Maximum unique jobs saved across all searches combined.
